archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY + SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST (Sustentabilidade + Água Tech)

theme.description: Limpo e vibrante, otimizado para projeção em telão de pitch. Tons verde esmeralda (bioenergia/terra) e azul ciano/acqua (água/pureza) sobre superfícies de alto contraste.

pitch_scale.kpi_label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x default) with high density data hierarchy for dashboard views.
layout_and_spacing.pitch_projection_rules: All primary KPI cards must have large values (36px+) visible from a distance on pitch screens.

components_structure.role_selector: Floating/Fixed Top Banner with 3 role tabs: 'Produtor Rural', 'Frivatti (Empresa)', 'Prefeitura (Gestão Pública)'. Allows instant role switch for demo.

sections: Hero Pitch Section with high-contrast badge and CTA 'Explorar Piloto Demo'
Modelo 4 Passos: Medir → Reduzir → Tratar → Reaproveitar (Interactive visual flow cards)
Impact Calculator / Pitch Stats (10 Propriedades, 10 Meses, Economia de Água + Biogás m³)
Parceiros do Piloto (Produtores + Frivatti + Prefeitura de Itapiranga/SC)

actions: Lançar Leitura com Foto do Hidrômetro

charts: Ranking de Eficiência Hídrica dos Produtores
Volume de Dejetos Tratados x Meta
Impacto Ambiental Agregado (Paz de Espírito Sanitária)
actions: Gerar Relatório PDF de Viabilidade do Piloto

components_structure.dejetos_biogas_module: Calculadora e registro de dejetos suínos, estimativa de produção de biogás (m³) e biofertilizante, e emissão de selo de rastreabilidade CONAMA.
components_structure.pdf_viability_report: Geração client-side / backend de relatório PDF do piloto de 10 meses com comparativo pré/pós e viabilidade financeira.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid to every button, link, tab, input, dialog, card, chart container and key KPI number.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Make sure the UI looks stunning when projected on a large screen (telão de pitch) with bold numbers and clear visual hierarchy.
